verdict.rationale: Ramp documents its own custom CSV exports, admin spend exports, and an open Developer API (OpenAPI spec with 174 paths) for retrieving transactions and other records, so data can be pulled out in open formats. Nothing shows a complete account-wide export or a documented offboarding path. missing for 10: documented full-account (all data types) export, explicit export format coverage beyond CSV for spend, account exit/offboarding and data-deletion documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of exports.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
